association_review.review_basis: Claim 1 identifies this exact route and GetImages action, which constructs the photo-feed query from timeslot/date and paging inputs. Remaining claims cover authorization, reviewed query-handler correspondence, user guard, feed state, orders, purchases, image reads, paginated response, and cache-store correspondence. This is useful for following photo browsing; the handler claim summarizes rather than enumerates every filter, ordering rule and response field. Cache naming supplies no shared/durable guarantee; reviewed correspondences are not compiler-resolved edges or runtime proof.
